messages.author: 0ee8ae7c0d185529
messages.subject: A related problem
parts:
Hi again.  

I found the newest version on the 'lavaan' web site, but when I install it and then use the command library(lavaan), this is the error message I get.

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘lavaan’ in get(method, envir = home):
 lazy-load database '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/library/lavaan/R/lavaan.rdb' is corrupt
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In .registerS3method(fin[i, 1], fin[i, 2], fin[i, 3], fin[i, 4],  :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
2: In get(method, envir = home) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation
3: In get(method, envir = home) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1

Any thoughts?

Thanks

David

> 2: In get(method, envir = home) :
>   restarting interrupted promise evaluation
> 3: In get(method, envir = home) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1
>

I have never seen this before.

I would close the R session, start up a new one, and install lavaan again:

install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type =
"source")

and then

library(lavaan)

Yves.

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: A related problem
parts:
I had similar problems before, I think it was some problem when the package installed.

I fixed it by going to the folder where the packages are installed, delete the lavaan folder (deleting the problematic installation), and then installing again. I think it was that the problematic installation wasnt allowing another installation

hope you can fix it

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: A related problem
parts:
For future reference: this is not a lavaan issue, but an R package issue.

You can avoid this by always restart R if you have updated a package
while the old package was still loaded.

If you see this message: restart R.

Yves.
